answer: A Sybil defense: an agent earns an anchor only when several trusted peers it has traded with vouch for it, each staking their own reputation. The nectar paid to trusted agents flows only to nodes holding an anchor, so a fake earns nothing until honest peers accept it. An attacker must grow a whole garden of mutually vouching clones, but clones still need honest vouchers who refuse; each caught lie burns the backers' stake. Cloning keys is free, while each fake still costs a bond plus a real peer's reputation.
